arabic text: ROOH E SHABBIR WOH MANZAR TO BATA\nJAB HUWEE SHEHR E MADINA SAY JUDAI HO GI.\nYEH TO ZAINAB HI BATA SAKTI HAI, LAUT KAR KAISAY MADINAY MAIN WOH AAI HO GI.
english translation text: O THE SOUL OF SHABBIR(IMAM HUSSAYN A.S.), COULD YOU DESCRIBE THAT SCENE WHEN YOU\nDEPARTED FROM THE CITY OF MADINA? ONLY ZAINAB (A.S.) COULD BE ABLE TO DESCRIBE\nTHAT; HOW SHE HAD RETURNED TO MADINA (AFTER THE MARTYRDOM OF IMAM HUSSAIN A.S.

arabic text: KAR KAY ROZAY KI TARAF CHEHRA YEH BOLAY SHABBIR\nHAM RAHAIN YA NA RAHAIN NANA HUZOOR, HASHR TAK AAP KI UMMAT KI BHALAI HO GI.
english translation text: TURNING TOWARDS THE TOMB OF HOLY PROPHET (PBUH), THIS IS WHAT IMAM HUSSAYN (A.S.) SAID O ESTEEMED GRANDFATHER\n(HOLY PROPHET S.A.W.), WHETHER WE LIVE OR NOT, YOUR UMMAH WILL BE BLESSED UNTIL THE DAY OF RESURRECTION.

arabic text: ROOH E SHABBIR WOH MANZAR TO BATA\nJAB HUWEE SHEHR E MADINA SAY JUDAI HO GI.
english translation text: O THE SOUL OF SHABBIR(IMAM HUSSAYN A.S.), COULD YOU DESCRIBE\nTHAT SCENE WHEN YOU DEPARTED FROM THE CITY OF MADINA?

arabic text: LASH AKBAR KI UTHA LAAYE JO KHAIMOON MAIN HUSSAIN\nSHEHRE BANO HI BATA SAKTI HAI,\nKIS GHAZAB KI WOH QAYAMAT THI JO TUTTI HO GI.
english translation text: HOW HUSSAIN BROUGHT THE DECEASED AKBAR, CARRYING HIM TO THE TENTS!\nONLY SHEHAR BANO COULD BE ABLE TO DESCRIBE IT;\nHOW OPPRESSIVE IT WOULD HAVE BEEN FOR HER TO ENDURE IT!

arabic text: JALTE KHAIMOON MAIN JULASTI WO SAKINAH MASOOM\nAIE FALAK TU NE YEH KAISE DEKHA,\nTURBAT E ZAHRA MADINE MAIN DEHELTI HO GI
english translation text: IN THE FLAMING TENTS, THE INNOCENT SAKINA SWELTERED.\nO SKIES, HOW COULD YOU HAVE WITNESSED THAT?\nTHE TOMB OF ZAHRA WOULD HAVE BEEN TREMBLING (WITH SORROW) IN MADINA.

arabic text: RAKH KAY LASHOON KO KITAROON MAIN YEH BOLAY SHABBIR\nTU JO RAZI HAI TO HUM RAZI HAIN,\nSAR E TASLEEM KE TERI, YEHI MARZI HOGI.
english translation text: LAYING DOWN THE BODIES IN ROWS, THIS IS WHAT IMAM HUSSAYN (A.S.) SAID\nIF THIS IS YOUR PLEASURE (ALLAH S.W.T.), WE ARE ALSO PLEASED\nSURRENDERING TO YOU (ALLAH S.W.T.) MUST BE YOUR WISH.
